craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Seed-ground mirrored; pomegranate show-play. Rejected: (a) play→sport → killed: play plays. Read aloud: ALL-world's SEED-ground … PALM-pome-GRAN-ate SHOW-play, O-god.

lines: All-world's seed-ground, first station — mirrored, waking-treasure;

reads_against.argmap: What ground seeds imitation? → Seed-ground first imitated; pomegranate-played.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
